messages.subject: Project Cedar - completion statement & monies required
messages.plaintextBody:
Rebecca, Isla,

The completion statement is attached. Balance due to the seller on completion is £12,771,452 (price £14.25m, less the £1.425m deposit and the £45k Unit 4 rent deposit, net of apportionments of £8,548 in your favour). Separately you'll need SDLT of £702,000 within 14 days (we'd estimated £706,250; it reconciles to £702,000 on the slice calculation), plus registration and our fees.

Please arrange for cleared funds to reach us by 10 December. Let me know if you'd like to talk it through.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
